book.title: ROM Pepa Paulo iŋgere panzi kalo-tawana tamâta simo Rom lawea

content: Kinzi Isrel ŋgu sizizâla ŋana Maro Kindeni ne vetâŋa kâ

Niŋgu-nambwe wukale, naŋa iloŋgu ndo tu kinzi Isrel ŋgu ma sipalele ilonzi kalonzi, ŋana Maro Kindeni ma iyautenzi piti lâ kondoma ilo. Aku ikura zo rârâni naŋa uru akai noŋa kaika papa i ŋana kinzi kâ.
Naŋa asama kilalanzi lâ, kala ŋine aporo atula pwataki tu kinzi ilonzi ndo tu sipaveta kuku vetâŋa rârâni Maro Kindeni ilo papa ŋinde. Taitu nenzi ilo-kalo ikeno soki-soki nâ.

Kinzi sizizâla ŋana nzâla ŋinde Maro Kindeni ipatea pa kinda tamâta ŋana ma tamo ilonda mbâra-mbâra lâ i nao. Kinzi situ warakanzi nâ nenzi kaika ikura ŋana ivetanzi sipâŋga mine. Mine kala kinzi ŋandai sipono muli pa Maro Kindeni ne pateâŋa ŋinde ŋga.
Kinda tasama tu Kirisi iveta ŋgua tukuŋa ipâŋga kanaŋo. Mine nde kinda tamâta ea kalonda tawana Kirisi, ande kinda ŋine rârâni tamo ilonda mbâra-mbâra lâ Maro Kindeni nao.

Mose muŋga iŋgere ŋgua pinde ŋananzi tamâta ŋinde kalonzi tawana tu ŋgua tukuŋa ikura tu ivetanzi sipâŋga ilonzi mbâra-mbâra lâ Maro Kindeni nao. Iŋgere ŋgua mine tu, “Tamâta ea kinzi uru sipaveta kuku ŋgua tukuŋa rârâni ikura zo rârâni, ande ŋgua tukuŋa ma ivetanzi tamâta ŋinde sikai via mao.”

Andeta kinda nenda kalo-tawana nâ nde nzâla ŋana tapâŋga ilonda mbâra-mbâra lâ Maro Kindeni nao. I kawa ŋgua ikeno lâ pepa tini mine tu, “Miki ma kaporo lâ warakami ilomi tu, ‘Ea ma ikâki ilâ samba ilo’ (ŋana ikai Kirisi indue imâ kâ), ande kaporo mine ndimo.
Aku miki ma kaporo tu, ‘Ea ma indue ilâ mateŋa nianzi’ (ŋana ikai Kirisi itaulo imâ kilo kâ), ande kaporo mine ndimo.”

Maro Kindeni iporo ŋgua mine tu, “Ŋgua ŋinde ŋandai ikeno malawae ŋanami ŋga. Ŋinde ikeno miki ilomi wa kawami ilo wa.” Ŋinde nde ŋgua ŋana kalo-tawana ne nzâla, nzâlani ndaina maka uru kaporo katula kilala pwataki mine tu,

“Ambo miki ma kaporo kapatula nemi kalo-tawana pwataki tu, ‘Yesu nde Maro Ŋalae’, aku ma kalomi tawana mao tu Maro Kindeni ipaŋo Yesu lâ mateŋa nianzi imandi imo via kilo, ande Maro Kindeni ma ikaimi piti lâ kondoma ilo.”
Ŋana tu nenda kalo-tawana iveta kinda tapâŋga ilonda mbâra-mbâra lâ Maro Kindeni nao. Aku kinda tapatula nenda kalo-tawana ŋinde pwataki lâ kawânda, kala Maro Kindeni ikai kinda piti lâ kondoma ilo.
Maro Kindeni kawa ŋgua ikeno lâ pepa tini mine tu, “Tamâta ea kalo tawana i, ande i ma ikai maŋeti ŋana ne kalo-tawana ŋinde, ande tia ndo.”

Ŋana tu Maro Kindeni uru iveta kie taituni panzi Juda tamâta wa kinzi tamâta lâ tinikoa ŋgu wa. Kinda tamâta rârâni nenda Maro Ŋalae taituni imo, aku i uru iveta kie ara ndo panzi tamâta ea sikai noŋa papa i tu ma ivilanzi.
Ŋana tu Maro Kindeni kawa ŋgua ikeno lâ pepa tini mine tu, “Tamâta ea sino pa Maro Kindeni tu ma ivilanzi, ande i ma ikainzi tamâta ŋinde rârâni piti lâ kondoma ilo.”

Andeta kaloŋo ŋga; ambo tamâta pinde kalonzi tawana Maro Kindeni tia, ande kinzi ma sikura tu sikai noŋa papa i mâsi mana, a? Ambo kinzi siloŋo i parina tia, ande ma sikura tu kalonzi tawana i mâsi mana, a? Ambo tamâta toŋge itula ŋgua panzi tia, ande kinzi ma sikura tu siloŋo i parina mâsi mana, a?

Ambo Maro Kindeni ma isupwa tamâta toŋge tia, ande tamâta toŋge ma ikura tu itula ŋgua panzi mâsi mana, a? Maro Kindeni kawa ŋgua ikeno lâ pepa tini mine tu, “Kinzi tamâta sindeka ndo ŋana simora tamâta toŋge imâ ŋana itula pâri ara panzi kâ.”
Kinzi Isrel ŋgu ilonzi pa pâri ara, nde tia
Andeta Isrel tamâta pinde nâ ilonzi pa pâri ara. Aisaia tamwata muŋga iporo ŋgua mine tu, “Maro Ŋalae, kinzi ŋandai kalonzi tawana ŋgua ŋinde maka katula panzi lâ ŋga.”
Mine nde tasama tu kinda tamâta ea taloŋo pâri ara, ande kinda ŋine nâ takura tu kalonda tawana. Aku ŋinde nde pâri ara ŋana Kirisi kâ.
Taitu naneŋgu kasoŋâŋa ikeno mine; tiambo kinzi Isrel ŋgu ŋandai siloŋo pâri ara ŋinde, tiya? Naŋa apaimi tu kinzi siloŋo lâ. Maro Kindeni kawa ŋgua ikeno lâ pepa tini mine tu,

content.text: “Nenzi sarawâŋa ilâ isala nia ndoni lâ tâno kulu, aku tamâta lâ lawea ndoni siloŋo nenzi ŋgua ŋinde.”

content: Aku naneŋgu kasoŋâŋa toŋge kilo kala ikeno mine; tiambo kinzi Isrel ŋgu sizizâla ŋana ŋgua ŋinde duvi kâ, tiya? Naŋa apaimi tu kinzi sisama ŋgua duvi lâ. Nanayoni Mose itula Maro Kindeni kawa ŋgua pwataki panzi Isrel ŋgu mine tu,

content.text: “Naŋa ma avilanzi tamâta ŋgu kaa kaa pinde, nenzi ilo-kalo ara tia. Aku naneŋgu vetâŋa ŋinde ma iveta miki kapadâda ku wisimi nâna.”

content: Aku muli ŋga Aisaia kala itula Maro Kindeni kawa ŋgua kie taituni tona. Maro Kindeni iporo kaika mine tu,

content.text: “‘Tamâta pinde ŋandai siroto ŋana naŋa kâ, andeta kinzi ŋinde sisânda kuluŋgu lâ. Mao nâ, tamâta pinde ŋandai sikasoŋanzi tininzi pinde ŋana naŋa kâ, andeta naŋa apatua lâ nia yo panzi tamâtani ndaina.”

content: Andeta Aisaia itula Maro Kindeni kawa ŋgua kie toŋge pwataki ŋananzi Isrel ŋgu mine tu,

content.text: “‘Ikura zo rârâni naŋa amo ao tiniŋgu ŋananzi ŋgu ŋinde. Naŋa atu aveta keŋgu ara nâ panzi. Andeta kinzi uru sipu naneŋgu ŋgua ututu, aku taŋanzi kaika ndo.”
